description: Form controls driven through the drive bridge.

steps.evaluate: (() => { const select = document.querySelector('#drive-select'); select.querySelectorAll('[value=delta]').forEach((option) => option.remove()); clearTimeout(window.__deltaTimer); window.__deltaTimer = setTimeout(() => select.add(new Option('Delta', 'delta')), 300); })()

tests.name: drags with the button held, as pointer sensors expect

steps.evaluate: (() => { window.__drag = []; if (window.__dragInstalled) return; window.__dragInstalled = true; for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'pointermove', 'pointerup']) document.addEventListener(type, (event) => { if (type === 'pointermove' && !event.buttons) return; window.__drag.push(type + ':' + (event.target.id || event.target.tagName)); }); })()

steps.expectValue: (() => { const d = window.__drag; return { first: d[0], last: d.at(-1), heldMoves: d.filter((e) => e.startsWith('pointermove')).length }; })()

tests.name: right- and middle-clicks like a real mouse

steps.evaluate: (() => { window.__mouse = []; if (window.__mouseInstalled) return; window.__mouseInstalled = true; const el = document.querySelector('#drive-hover-target'); for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'pointerup', 'mouseup', 'click', 'auxclick', 'contextmenu']) el.addEventListener(type, (event) => { window.__mouse.push(type + ':' + event.button); if (type === 'contextmenu') event.preventDefault(); }); })()

tests.name: left- and double-clicks like a real mouse

steps.evaluate: (() => { window.__left = []; if (window.__leftInstalled) return; window.__leftInstalled = true; const el = document.querySelector('#drive-hover-target'); for (const type of ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'pointerup', 'mouseup', 'click', 'dblclick']) el.addEventListener(type, (event) => window.__left.push(type + ':' + event.button + ':' + event.detail + (type === 'click' ? ':' + event.constructor.name : ''))); })()

tests.name: fires blur even when the window is in the background

steps.expectValue: (() => { const input = document.querySelector('#drive-input'); let fired = false; input.addEventListener('blur', () => { fired = true; }, { once: true }); input.focus(); input.blur(); return { hasFocus: document.hasFocus(), fired }; })()
